interaction: H-272 direct-label multiplicative contextual readout × independently trained C1 seed-4 parent family

scope.owner: root controls source review, profile/fit admission, final deployment composition, and all grade admission

motivation.exposure: Previously inspected fold-0 evaluation: 468 groups / 141 components; discovery evidence only, no public forecast.

multiplicative_vs_frozen_parent.uncertainty: All nonzero fixed raw blends were positive on this exposed fold, but their paired component intervals include zero; this motivates one bounded parent-family follow-up, not a gain/public-best claim.

screen_parent.role: cleanfold family/seed matched screen parent; not an exact teacher-ancestry match to the current full-data public-best base

membership.source_qualification: Join and validate (source, row_group); train and valid use separate namespaces. The 463 same-integer train-source collisions are not leakage. Valid-source fit/evaluation overlap is zero and evaluation component overlap is zero. The screen must preserve these source-qualified and component checks.

recipe_summary.family: plain GRU, 256 hidden, 2 layers, 211 input features, primary pair plus 21 auxiliary outputs

full_data_parent.role: deployment-only final head parent; no local score or held-out claim
full_data_parent.family_and_seed_match: Same seed-4, plain GRU 256x2 checkpoint tensor shapes and source-code identity as the cleanfold screen parent.
full_data_parent.nonmatched_training_ancestry: The full-data parent uses ab67_final_since_s3/ab67_final_since_s4 and prop_v1; the cleanfold parent uses c20260929_since_s3_f0/c20260929_since_s4_f0 and c20260929_prop_f0. The source lineage and propensity inputs differ. Do not treat the cleanfold screen as an exact replication of the full-data parent's training ancestry.

propensity.provenance_gap: Only model.pt/history.json were found under artifacts/runs/prop_v1; independently bind its data/membership provenance before admitting the all-data head fit. Do not substitute the fold-0 propensity model.

fold0_contamination.claim: This parent was trained on 374 of the exposed 468 fold-0 evaluation groups. The full-data head is fit for deployment only; no fold-0 result may be attached to it.

current_public_best_reference.deployment_rule: Keep this package as the fallback. The proposed head uses the base component c20261004_combo_s4_final; later served-endpoint comparison must explicitly decide whether it replaces or composes with the existing combo_head, and must compare the complete candidate endpoint against this package. No such choice is made here.

followup_recipe.scientific_change: Train only the multiplicative contextual readout against direct clipped primary labels, on the declared frozen seed-4 C1 parent. Do not change the parent's training, targets, weights, preprocessing, or ancestry.

readout.initialization: Initialize ConditionalReadoutHeads with head seed 3, then make only the multiplicative control trainable. This preserves the H272 multiplicative branch initialization order while removing unused trained controls from this follow-up. Verify by comparing the selected branch's initial tensor hashes in a small source test.

objective.target: clip(original_label, -2, 2) for the primary pair only
objective.main_row_weights: Same split's independently trained propensity model, prop_power=2, prop_eps=0.03, valid_true_mask=0.03; mask_weight=false.
objective.teacher_inputs: none; do not append readout teacher columns. The frozen parent's own teacher ancestry remains preserved and is not changed.
objective.loss: H272 primary-pair weighted MSE, denominator per 2,000-row chunk, epsilon 1e-8; official evaluation metric remains unchanged.
objective.parent: Entire parent model is eval/frozen; only the multiplicative readout parameters update.

training.checkpoint: fixed epoch 1 after completing both epochs; no metric-based epoch or blend selection
training.gradient_clip: max norm 1.0 for the selected head
training.time_reference: H272 four-head fit used 1,941.2489 seconds for 29,840 updates. Linear update-count scaling gives about 1,968.6 seconds for 30,260 updates, but one-head timing, data setup, and export were not measured; do not use this estimate as fit admission or truncate epochs to meet it.
training.execution_gate: No profile or fit until root reviews this source proposal and admits fresh GPU/device quota, RAM/VRAM, exact source/data identities, and a whole-worker budget that covers startup, both fixed epochs, checkpointing, and export. Keep the original measured optimization budget intact.

screen_fold0.fit_membership: Exactly 10,535 train-source plus 1,405 fit-valid-source groups; exclude all 468 fold-0 evaluation groups and reject source-qualified group or component overlap.
screen_fold0.export: Stream parent and candidate outputs to FP32 memmaps in the exact frozen valid order (1,873 groups x 20,000 rows x 2). Export the evaluation and selected masks; only 468 evaluation groups and official selected rows may enter the frozen grader. Do not materialize multiple full arrays in RAM.
screen_fold0.comparisons: Parent baseline alpha=0; multiplicative standalone alpha=1; and raw preclip mixtures (1-alpha)*parent + alpha*head at alpha 0.1, 0.25, and 0.5. Report every declared endpoint, no weight selection.
screen_fold0.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over the same 141 frozen connected components, 2,000 replicates, seed 271828; fold 0 remains exposed development evidence only.

full_data_deployment_head.fit_membership: Exactly all 10,606 train-source and 1,505 valid-source groups in the parent's 12,111-group full-data universe; no held-out claim.
full_data_deployment_head.evaluation: No local score, no fold-0 grade, and no public forecast. This is a deployment artifact only after the separate cleanfold source review and root admission.
full_data_deployment_head.admission_dependency: Resolve and hash-bind prop_v1's data/membership provenance before creating a runnable packet.

serving_feasibility.assessment: Plausible to implement in the existing native streaming engine, not yet implemented or validated.
serving_feasibility.why_plausible: The current E416 native wrapper already computes the causal 99-column StreamFeatures context and calls FastRnn once per row. FastRnn internally forms the 512-wide concatenation [last recurrent state, projected input] before head.0. The additional rank-32 control is 22,722 FP32 parameters (90,888 bytes) and about 22,720 multiply-accumulates per row, roughly 2.3% of a plain 256x2 GRU's approximately 0.98M matrix multiply-accumulates per row; this is an architecture estimate, not a runtime measurement.
required_engine_work: Expose the parent's pre-head [recurrent, projected] representation to the native contextual head without changing state-update order.
Use StreamFeatures' already computed context; do not recompute or reorder event features in a separate Python path.
Add the multiplicative rank-32 correction and anchor gate in the native scorer, with model hash/shape validation and existing sequence reset semantics.
Preserve predict(data_point), need_prediction behavior, causal row order, deterministic inference, and sequence-state reset on seq_ix changes.
required_pre_zip_gates: Independent FP32 Rust-vs-PyTorch readout forward tests over hand-built and randomized hidden/context/anchor fixtures, including zero initialization and saturation; use declared numerical tolerances.

Full predictor parity against the frozen Python reference on multiple supplied sequences, including warmup, row causality, two consecutive sequences, reset, and repeated-call determinism; compare raw outputs before official clipping.

Measure actual package bytes (must remain below the 20 MB campaign envelope), evaluator RSS (<=4 GB), and representative 1-CPU portal runtime (<=60 minutes) against the current public-best package; keep the current public package as fallback.
Validate the exact complete served endpoint against the existing public-best package only after root separately admits the exposure-appropriate comparison.

required_source_tests_before_review: Production function computes parent_primary * (1 + tanh(correction)); a hand-computed fixture catches additive/raw blend or postclip drift.
Zero-initialized multiplicative head is exactly anchor-valued; only multiplicative parameters change during a synthetic update; all parent tensors remain bitwise unchanged.
Seed-3 selected branch initialization matches the multiplicative branch of a freshly seeded H272 ConditionalReadoutHeads instance.

Fold-0 membership joins use (source, row_group), assert zero valid-source evaluation overlap and zero component overlap, and reject the prior 463 integer-alias false positives as an invalid join strategy.
Full-data arm uses the exact 12,111-group input set and refuses any fold-0 grading/claim; prop_v1 identity is mandatory before runtime admission.
Parent producer sidecar compares to actual model_ep3.pt checkpoint hash and independently validates model.pt alias bytes/tensor parity.
